description: Run an action definition or usage to completion and report its output parameters (the ExecuteAction RPC, the REPL's %run). Inputs are bound by parameter name. Under an explore schedule every linearization the model admits is run and the answer is the set of distinct `outcomes` with how the exploration ended, instead of one run's outputs. The run is bounded by the service's OPENSYSML_MAX_* budgets; a budget hit is reported in `error`. `advance`, `seed`, `draws` and `clockStep` are the run options of `sysml -advance`, `-seed`, `-draws` and `-clock-step`. The result is the ExecuteActionResponse as protojson writes it.

actionSymbolId.description: qualified name of the action definition or usage to run

advance.description: simulated time in seconds to run for (sysml -advance): the behavior is started and its clock moved by this much; an action not completed by then reports that in error. Unset runs to completion

clockStep.description: the step in seconds the run's clock ticks by (sysml -clock-step); 0 is a continuous clock

draws.description: how the run resolves RandomFunctions draws (sysml -draws): random (default, from seed), min, max or average

inputs.description: input parameter name to value; each value is a protojson Value. Example arms: {"intValue":"7"}, {"realValue":1.5}, {"boolValue":true}, {"stringValue":"x"}, {"quantity":{"realMagnitude":5.0,"unit":"m"}}, {"enumLiteral":{"literalId":"Colors::red"}}

modelHash.description: the model_hash a parse answered; give this, or paths and/or sources to parse first

paths.description: model files to parse as one model, absolute or relative to the workspace root

performerSymbolId.description: qualified name of a part/usage, or a path from one as Mission::mission.vehicle, whose object the action is performed on; empty performs it outside any object

schedule.description: scheduling policy for choice points: declared, reverse (the default), seed:<n>, or explore[:runs=<n>,depth=<d>] which runs every linearization and answers with outcomes

seed.description: seed the model's own draws (weighted decisions, random functions) are taken from (sysml -seed); the same seed draws the same run

sources.description: documents given inline, parsed with paths as one model

language.description: sysml or kerml; empty is inferred from path's extension, sysml when it has none

path.description: name the document is reported by in diagnostics and indexed under; a .kerml extension makes it KerML unless language says otherwise

text.description: the document's source text; empty is an empty document

strictConformance.description: judge the documents as conforming SysML v2: notation no pinned production admits is an error rather than a warning

name: execute_action
